title: Filipino-Style Tofu Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful stew made with tofu and a variety of Filipino-inspired spices and herbs. Serve with steamed rice for a satisfying meal.

ingredients.name: stew
ingredients.notes: your favorite store-bought or homemade stew mix

ingredients.name: yummy
ingredients.notes: your favorite mixed vegetables (e.g. bell peppers, carrots, potatoes)

instructions: Heat oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add onion and garlic and sauté until softened.
Add stew mix and cook according to package instructions.
Add tofu, yummy, soy sauce, and fish sauce (if using). Stir to combine.
Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 20-25 minutes.
Season with black pepper and salt to taste.
Garnish with chopped green onions and a sprinkle of toasted sesame seeds (optional).
